project_type: Next.js 16.4.3 App Router, plain CSS component files + globals.css
build_system: Next.js built-in (Turbopack/webpack). No CSS preprocessors. PostCSS/autoprefixer included via Next.js. Vendor-prefix warnings (e.g. -webkit-box-orient) are non-fatal.
test_framework: No JS test framework for CSS changes. Browser DevTools viewport simulation is the integration-level test. `npm run build` is the compilation gate.
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` from the repo root (c:\Users\Lenovo\git\provenance_portfolio). Exit code 0 = pass. CSS vendor-prefix warnings are expected and acceptable. After build passes, verify visually in browser DevTools: Fix 1 @ 360px, Fix 2 @ 430px, Fix 3 scroll filter row, Fix 4 scroll filter row, Fix 5 @ 320px card title ellipsis, Fix 6 @ 390px (2 columns) and 520px (4 columns).
environment_constraints: Windows / PowerShell. Run all commands from repo root. Do not restart dev server. Do not push to remote.
contribution_requirements: No new libraries. No changes to base styles, animations, colours, desktop/tablet layouts, or business logic. All edits must be inside existing @media (max-width: ...) blocks or new mobile-only blocks. Fix the root cause of overflow — do not use global overflow-x: hidden.
key_patterns: Each component has its own CSS file in src/components/. Global styles in src/app/globals.css. Media queries follow narrowest-breakpoint-last convention within a file (e.g. 1023px block comes before 374px block). The @media (max-width: 374px) blocks are labelled with a comment like '/* NARROW MOBILE SCREENS (320px–374px) */'.
